channel.title: An Phoblacht / Republican News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from An Phoblacht / Republican News (republican-news.org)

item.title: Please donate for Irish Unity
item.description: Every year we reach out for support to those who may be willing to support the Irish cause.Our national day is only once a year, but your support would make a difference every day of the year.

item.title: Tom Smith
item.description: Dublin Brigade 2nd Battalion IRA Volunteer Tom Smith was born on the22nd of March 1948 in Dublin’s southside close to the banks of theindustrial waterway, the Grand Canal.

item.title: The Hillcrest Bar bomb
item.description: James Kane still remembers the moment it happened. Fifty years ago, hewas about to sit down for dinner when a massive explosion shook theground. Instantly, he knew: it had to be a bomb.

item.title: Court of Appeal fails to halt controversial extraditions
item.description: The Court of Appeal in Dublin has upheld a decision to extradite tworepublicans, now both in their 70s, to British jurisdiction for offencesrelated to an INLA attack on the Crown Forces over 50 years ago.

item.title: Starmer’s contempt on show as genocide expands
item.description: In an unheralded visit to Belfast and Cork this week, the British Prime Minister KeirStarmer sought to normalise his government’s colonial relationship withIreland while making an absurd swipe at the “intolerable” politics ofIrish-language rap trio Kneecap.

item.title: PSNI’s high-tech war on Irish public
item.description: The PSNI are under growing pressure over a secret seven-year £5.5million contract with an unnamed Israeli security firm. Campaigners warnthat the “tools of apartheid” have been used to wage a high-tech war onpolitical activism in the northeast.

item.title: Crown Force raids in Derry
item.description: Saoradh said it “utterly condemns” the “latest provocative incursion” byheavily armed British Army personnel into nationalist communities inDerry.

item.title: Britain ‘was handed peace process on a plate’ - Adams
item.description: Former Sinn Féin president Gerry Adams has mounted a robust defence inLondon’s High Court, rejecting a politically driven attempt to rewritehistory rather than a serious search for truth.

item.title: Trump’s silver lining after White House horror show
item.description: An expression of support for Irish unity by US President Donald Trumpwas a pleasant surprise at the end of an enervating day in Washington DCwhich will be remembered for Taoiseach Micheal Martin’s kowtowing to Trump at theannual St Patrick’s Day shamrock ceremony.

item.title: Adams wins as civil case is halted early
item.description: A civil case in London seeking to hold Gerry Adams personally responsible for three IRA attacks in Englandhas ended in victory for the former Sinn FéinPresident.
